detail.workspaceHint: Map remains live underneath this drill-down.

workspace.cockpitDescription: Your command deck for cash, route health, alerts, and next operational moves.
workspace.fleetDescription: Manage aircraft as productive assets: deploy idle capacity, monitor condition, and control acquisitions.
workspace.networkDescription: Plan and tune the network: open routes, adjust fares, and line up capacity with demand.
workspace.leaderboardDescription: Track the competitive field, compare operators, and scout rivals before they out-position you.
workspace.corporateDescription: Review liquidity, fixed costs, route profitability, and bankruptcy risk in one finance workspace.
workspace.aboutDescription: Reference material, protocol context, language controls, and project links.
workspace.airportDescription: Inspect airport-level demand, hub posture, and local flight activity without leaving the world map.
workspace.aircraftDescription: Inspect one aircraft in detail: route assignment, condition, seat mix, and latest operating performance.
workspace.modeGuestDetail: You can inspect the world and the competition, but route, fleet, and finance controls stay locked until you launch an airline.
workspace.modeObserverDetail: You are browsing without an active operator context. Launch or restore an airline to unlock management workspaces.
workspace.modeCompetitorDetail: You are studying another airline. Operate your own network again when you are ready to act.
workspace.modeRestrictedDetail: Your airline is in a constrained state. Prioritize balance-sheet recovery before expansion.
workspace.modeLiveDetail: You are controlling a live airline. Every move now affects the network, balance sheet, and competitive posture.

join.badge: Free to play · No account needed
join.heroDescription: A free, open-source airline tycoon on a live world map. Real routes, real flight times, rival airlines — and your planes keep flying while you're away. No ads, no pay-to-win.
join.footer: Open source · MIT License · Powered by the Nostr protocol

realTimeFlights.title: Real-time flights
realTimeFlights.description: Routes resolve in actual real-world time. A 7-hour transatlantic flight takes 7 real hours — check in anytime.

network.title: Real routes, real demand
network.description: Open routes between 6,000+ real airports. Passenger demand follows real population and economy data, and shifts with the seasons.

fleet.title: A real fleet
fleet.description: 35 real aircraft, from turboprops to the A380, unlocked as your airline grows. Lease or buy, maintain, and trade on the used market.

decentralized.title: Yours to keep
decentralized.description: Your airline lives on the open Nostr network — no central game server, and nobody can take it away from you.

competition.title: One shared live world
competition.description: Every airline flies on the same map. Rivals compete for the same passengers on the same routes, ranked on live leaderboards.

roadmap.title: On the roadmap
roadmap.subtitle: Planned — not in the game yet.

company.title: Public companies
company.description: Shares, IPOs, mergers and hostile takeovers.

alliances.title: Alliances
alliances.description: Codeshares and joint networks with other players.
